main_text.l: cunq; tùm Romulus, tùm Augustus construxerant, sub ipso Barbari di-ruerunt.

Orientis Imperium permul-ta adhuc secula floruit: Sed & il-lud partim à Scythis, partim à Saracenis ita debilitatum fuit, ut præter urbem Constantinopolim & vicinas quasdam provincias vix quicquam obtineret, donec tandem A.C.1453. h. e. ante 200. ferè annosà Mahummede Turcarum Imperatore, captâ Constantinopoli penitùs extinguere,[?] tur;

page.notes: The left margin holds the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The faint ghost text in the right margin and below the title block is show-through and is not transcribed. "extinguere," ends a line with no visible hyphen before "tur;", so the join is uncertain and marked.
